_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Try following the trail outside the castle, it might lead you to the key.
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: Kalenin dışındaki izi takip etmeyi dene, seni anahtara götürebilir.

The Envoy Part II#001.src: Just follow the road to the north to find my friend. Watch out, she doesn't like humans much.
The Envoy Part II#001.dst: Arkadaşımı bulmak için kuzeye giden yolu takip et. Dikkat et, insanları pek sevmez.

The Envoy Part II#002.src: You need the key before you leave!

The Envoy Part II#004.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factory's operations.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: Fikir, iki türün de fabrikanın işleyişinde eşit rol almasıydı.
The Envoy Part II#004.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#005.src: We need those keys to get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: İçeri girip fabrikayı bir kez daha kapatmak için o anahtarlar lazım.
The Envoy Part II#005.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The Corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: Corkian'lar anahtarlarından kolay kolay vazgeçmez, o yüzden Avos'larla başlamalıyız.
The Envoy Part II#006.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#007.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief, but... The border's closed due to tensions.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: En iyisi şefe sormak ama... Gerginlik yüzünden sınır kapalı.

The Envoy Part II#008.src: Fortunately, there's a catapult that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there!
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: Neyse ki buranın kuzeybatısındaki bir köyde işimize yarayacak bir mancınık var. Orada buluşalım!

The Envoy Part II#009.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use!
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: Biliyordum! Burada işimize yarayacak bir şey vardı!
The Envoy Part II#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#010.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you'll have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: Fırlatmak için elektrobüyü kullanmam gerekecek, o yüzden yalnız gitmen lazım.
The Envoy Part II#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'm so jealous of the chief, he gets to live in the fanciest house on the hill!
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: Şefi çok kıskanıyorum, tepedeki en şatafatlı evde yaşıyor!

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Hmm, no gears or goggles... You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: Hmm, ne dişli var ne gözlük... Sen Corkian bir insan değilsin.
The Envoy Part II#014.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#015.src: We saw your battle with "Mech X" at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#015.dst: "Mech X" ile iskeledeki savaşını yukarıdan gördük. Sana güvenebileceğimize inanıyorum.
The Envoy Part II#015.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Can't you humans see I'm meditating?
The Envoy Part II#016.dst: Siz insanlar meditasyon yaptığımı görmüyor musunuz?

The Envoy Part II#017.src: I don't see why we're helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#017.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#018.src: You should head back to Maxie with the key.

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Excellent! I'll hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: Harika! Şimdilik onu ben saklayayım. Corkian'ların Anahtarı'nı almaya odaklanalım.
The Envoy Part II#019.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#020.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I... I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: Onu kalenin içindeki bir kasada tutuyorlar. Ben... açıkçası oraya nasıl girilir bilmiyorum.
The Envoy Part II#020.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#021.src: It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: Kalenin içinde, sağda. Orada her zaman {~} muhafız oluyor, gözden kaçıramazsın.

The Envoy Part II#022.src: Something has happened in the vault.

The Envoy Part II#023.src: Don't go in there, it's under control.

The Envoy Part II#024.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow the trail.
The Envoy Part II#024.dst: Makineler nedense tarım ürünlerine bulanmıştı ve işimize yarayacak bir iz bıraktılar. Fabrikayla savaşmakta ciddiysen izi takip et.
The Envoy Part II#024.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#025.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here...
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: Mo'in. Yukarıdaki adamı görüyor musun? Ben geldiğimden beri bir milim kıpırdamadı...
The Envoy Part II#025.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#026.src: ...I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#026.dst: ...Bence gerçekten çiftçi değil. Beni takip et.
The Envoy Part II#026.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#028.src: That model was a S-{~}... It's warned the others. Let's go.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: O model bir S-{~} idi... Diğerlerini uyardı. Hadi gidelim.

The Envoy Part II#030.src: You did?! Great! Now we need to meet at the factory. The real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#030.dst: Aldın mı?! Harika! Şimdi fabrikada buluşmalıyız. Asıl zor kısım başlıyor.

The Envoy Part II#031.src: You hear a distant rumbling sound...

The Envoy Part II#032.src: An engraving on the pillar reads: Reunite three wise creatures to open the way.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: Sütundaki bir oymada şöyle yazıyor: Yolu açmak için üç bilge yaratığı yeniden bir araya getir.

The Envoy Part II#033.src: You dare intrude on me while I am sculpting?! You shall pay with your life!
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: Ben heykel yaparken rahatsız etmeye nasıl cüret edersin?! Bunu canınla ödeyeceksin!

The Envoy Part II#034.src: Another miserable whelp has come to steal my knowledge? I won't let you!
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: Bilgimi çalmaya bir sefil velet daha mı geldi? İzin vermeyeceğim!

The Envoy Part II#035.src: So... You've managed to make it past my family. Pathetic aren't they?
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: Demek... Ailemi geçmeyi başardın. Acınası değiller mi?

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Let me show you a real challenge!

The Envoy Part II#037.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#037.dst: Maxie'nin ev anahtarıyla Maxie'nin evine gir

The Envoy Part II#040.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.

The Envoy Part II#042.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: İçeri girmek için iki anahtar lazım. Biri Avos'lardan, biri Corkian'lardan.
The Envoy Part II#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: En iyisi şefe sormak. Ama gerginlik yüzünden sınır kapalı.
The Envoy Part II#046.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#050.dst: Avos şefini bul. Fabrika anahtarını iste.
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#052.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#055.dst: Avos halkına sorarak Avos Şefi'ni bul. Avos Şefi: -{~}, -{~}

The Envoy Part II#057.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: Şef, halkının burada hoş karşılandığını söyledi.
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#058.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#060.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#061.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: Kuş insanlarla dolu bir köye mancınıkla fırlayıp da fark edilmemek olmaz.
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#062.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#062.dst: Neyse, ne için geldiğini biliyoruz. Avos fabrika anahtarı.
The Envoy Part II#062.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#064.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: Aradığın anahtar en iyi korunan tapınağımızın derinliklerinde saklı.
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#065.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#065.dst: Tapınağa ulaşmak için buranın kuzeyindeki yolu takip et. Büyük üstatla konuş, seni içeri alacak.
The Envoy Part II#065.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#066.src: Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#067.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: Eh, savaşçı geldi. Emrimi aldım ama yine de bunun kötü bir fikir olduğunu söylüyorum.
The Envoy Part II#067.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#068.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: Bu anahtarı bir daha asla kullanılmasın diye sakladık.
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#069.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: Aşağıda çağırdığımız yaratıklar herkese düşman. Avos'lara bile.
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#070.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#070.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#071.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#071.dst: Evimin arkasında buluşalım, sana yolu göstereceğim.
The Envoy Part II#071.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#072.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#072.dst: Büyük üstatla evinin arkasında buluş, boşluğu geç ve tapınağa gir.

The Envoy Part II#073.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#073.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#075.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: Bana hepiniz aynı davranıyorsunuz. Neyse, buyur bakalım.
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Find the key inside the temple.

The Envoy Part II#077.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#077.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#078.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#078.dst: İlk anahtarla evindeki Maxie'nin yanına dön.

The Envoy Part II#079.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#082.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#082.dst: Bence önce gidip kasanın kendisini bir keşfedelim, sonra bir yolunu buluruz.
The Envoy Part II#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#085.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#085.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#086.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#086.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#087.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#087.dst: Durun. Maxie haklıymış. Özür dilerim. Mech X kasayı hiç yokmuş gibi delip anahtarı aldı.
The Envoy Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#089.src: Look for the hidden mech base.

The Envoy Part II#090.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#090.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#093.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#093.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#094.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#094.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#095.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#095.dst: İyi denemeydi, makine! Beni ikna etmeye yetmez!
The Envoy Part II#095.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#096.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#096.dst: RAPOR... KİMLİK İFŞA OLDU... İKİ YETKİSİZ DAVETSİZ MİSAFİR... ÜSSÜN DIŞINDA.
The Envoy Part II#096.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#099.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#099.dst: O model bir S-{~} idi, yani diğerlerini uyardı. Beni takip et.
The Envoy Part II#099.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#101.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#102.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#102.dst: Sanırım doğru yerde olduğumuzu rahatça söyleyebiliriz.
The Envoy Part II#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#103.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#103.dst: Sen içeri dal ve ihtiyacımız olanı bul. Ben seni buradan korurum.
The Envoy Part II#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#104.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#104.dst: O yeni fabrika makinesini bulup yok etmelisin.
The Envoy Part II#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#105.src: Retrieve the key from the base.

The Envoy Part II#106.dst: DAVETSİZ MİSAFİR TESPİT EDİLDİ. YOK ET.
The Envoy Part II#106.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#107.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#107.dst: Corkus acı çekmeli... Fabrikayı kapattılar, bizi içine kilitlediler. İki anahtarı da alınca orayı açabiliriz ve bu anahtarı ASLA alamayacaksın.
The Envoy Part II#107.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#109.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#109.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#110.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#110.dst: Kuzeybatı yolunu takip et ve fabrikaya batı tarafından gir. Orada buluşuruz.
The Envoy Part II#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#112.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#112.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#113.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#113.dst: Bu sıradan bir savaş olmayacak. Fabrika son teknoloji. Saf elektrobüyüden bir varlık tarafından yönetiliyor.
The Envoy Part II#113.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#114.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#114.dst: Corkus'un en zeki adamı Cerid, kendisinden bile zeki bir varlık yaratmak için yıllarını harcadı...
The Envoy Part II#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#115.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#115.dst: Şimdi o varlık fabrikayı çarpık bir ahlak anlayışıyla yönetiyor. Neden kapatıldığını anlamak zor değil.
The Envoy Part II#115.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#116.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#116.dst: Bir de.. B-ben sana büyümle bu botları yaptım. Meğer bir şeyler yapmakta epey iyiymişim.
The Envoy Part II#116.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#117.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#117.dst: Bir de teşekkür etmek istedim. Seninle savaşırken gerçekten bir fark yarattığımı hissettim. Hazır olduğunda fabrika kapılarına yürümen yeterli.
The Envoy Part II#117.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#119.src: Mo'in, {u}! I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#119.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Fabrika hakkında bulabildiğim her şeyi araştırıyordum.
The Envoy Part II#119.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#120.src: ARE YOU INCAPABLE OF READING THE SIGN ON THE DOOR? THE FACTORY IS CLOSED. WE ARE NOT ACCEPTING VISITORS FOR TOURS RIGHT NOW.
The Envoy Part II#120.dst: KAPIDAKİ TABELAYI OKUYAMIYOR MUSUN? FABRİKA KAPALI. ŞU AN TUR İÇİN ZİYARETÇİ KABUL ETMİYORUZ.

The Envoy Part II#121.src: I have learned so much on our adventure. One day, if you ever need me, I will be there. You have an ally in this Corkian.
The Envoy Part II#121.dst: Bu macerada çok şey öğrendim. Bir gün bana ihtiyacın olursa yanında olacağım. Bu Corkian'da bir müttefikin var.
